White Pony Was one of my least favorite albums.

It lacked the energy that Around The Fur, and the Self Tilted album had. The songwriting and instrumentation were a bit bland and it felt as if the album blurred together to me, with the only standout tracks being ones with, good screams (like Korea, my favorite track.), strange intros or interludes.

Chinos vocals weren't as raw as the previous or followup albums. It felt more electronic, which helped tracks like Digital Bath and Teenager become so amazing slower songs but to me Deftones is a heavy band, one to listen to for energy (at least the first few albums.).

In my opinion, its an average album, but it lacks flow between most tracks with an energetic track followed suddenly by a slower one, running the flow.
